description: Check a change before committing it: compares the React Native or Expo project as committed at a git revision (default HEAD) with the working tree, and lists what got fixed, what is new and how versions moved. Call it after an upgrade or a dependency change. Read-only: the committed version is unpacked into a temporary folder outside the project and deleted.

base.description: Git revision to compare with: HEAD (default), HEAD~1, a branch, tag or commit SHA.

offline.description: Default true: both sides are scanned without network requests.

path.description: Folder of the React Native or Expo app, inside a git repository.

name: verify_upgrade
